title: Callbacks and Tracing
summary: This module provides core components for handling events and tracing execution within LangChain applications, enabling observability and custom event processing. It includes base callback handlers, file-based logging, and utilities for managing and collecting run traces.

nodes.label: Base Async Event Handler
nodes.title: AsyncCallbackHandler
nodes.description: Provides an abstract base for implementing asynchronous callback logic across various LangChain events like LLM calls, chains, and tools.

nodes.label: File Logging Callback
nodes.title: FileCallbackHandler
nodes.description: A callback handler that writes all execution events and outputs to a specified file, useful for persistent logging and debugging.

nodes.label: Logger Integration Callback
nodes.title: LoggingCallbackHandler
nodes.description: A callback handler that integrates with Python's standard logging module to output events at a specified log level.

nodes.label: Group Synchronous Operations
nodes.title: trace_as_chain_group
nodes.description: Context manager to group multiple synchronous LangChain operations into a single logical trace run for better observability.

nodes.label: Group Asynchronous Operations
nodes.title: atrace_as_chain_group
nodes.description: Context manager to group multiple asynchronous LangChain operations into a single logical trace run for better observability.

nodes.label: Dispatch Custom Sync Event
nodes.title: dispatch_custom_event
nodes.description: Allows dispatching arbitrary synchronous custom events to active callback handlers within a run context.

nodes.label: Dispatch Custom Async Event
nodes.title: adispatch_custom_event
nodes.description: Allows dispatching arbitrary asynchronous custom events to active callback handlers within a run context.

nodes.label: Collect LLM Usage Metrics
nodes.title: get_usage_metadata_callback
nodes.description: Context manager for tracking and aggregating token usage and other metadata from LLM calls across different models.

nodes.label: Collect All Execution Traces
nodes.title: collect_runs
nodes.description: Context manager that gathers all run objects generated during its scope, providing a list of traced execution details.

nodes.label: Core Tracing & Run Management
nodes.title: _TracerCore
nodes.description: Abstract base class that defines the fundamental mechanisms for creating, updating, and persisting execution runs and their relationships.

groups.label: Callback Implementations
groups.title: Callback Implementations
groups.description: Concrete and abstract classes for handling various events during LangChain execution.

groups.label: Tracing Context Managers
groups.title: Tracing Context Managers
groups.description: Utilities for defining and managing the scope of execution traces and run collection.

groups.label: Event Dispatchers
groups.title: Event Dispatchers
groups.description: Functions for programmatically sending custom events to active callback handlers.

groups.label: Core Tracing Engine
groups.title: Core Tracing Engine
groups.description: The foundational abstract class for managing the lifecycle and structure of execution runs.
